description: easy-compact — see what every request costs, know when to compact, and compact in one click.

plugins.name: easy-compact
plugins.description: The Easy Compact bar above the input and the Easy Compact pane for Claude Code: live context, cost and plan limits, when to compact, a one-click Easy Compact that saves before compacting, and an optional Easy Auto that does it for you past a range you set. Requires Claude Code 2.1.295+.
